title: Lightweight Container Runtime Built with Bash
longDescription:
– Built a lightweight container runtime in Bash utilizing chroot, Linux namespaces and Btrfs filesystem snapshots
– Implemented process, network, hostname and filesystem isolation using namespaces and virtual Ethernet pairs
– Added container image pulling, process execution management and basic CPU and memory resource controls
– Explored container internals across filesystem isolation, networking, namespaces and runtime lifecycle management
